description: Keyword ideas for a seed keyword, each with Google search volume, CPC, competition, keyword difficulty and search intent; up to 100 ideas in one $0.04 call (DataForSEO Labs). Use when you need related keywords to target. volume = avg monthly searches, cpc in USD, competition 0-1, difficulty 0-100. No ideas returns empty results (still charged). Bad input is free; upstream errors are not charged. Price: $0.04 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base); pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code or country name, used when locationCode is absent.

includeMonthly.description: Add each idea's monthly search volumes.

keyword.description: Seed keyword to expand (at most 80 characters; whitespace, control characters and case are normalised; a seed then empty, over 10 words or over 80 characters is a free 400).

languageCode.description: Language code (2-letter). Default en. An unsupported location falls back to 2840 (United States) with en (or the requested language if the United States offers it); a supported location with a language it does not offer uses that location's default language (en if offered). Either way market.fallback is true and market.warnings says what was used.

locationCode.description: DataForSEO location code. Default 2840 (United States); an unsupported code falls back to 2840 (United States).

name: keyword_ideas
title: Keyword ideas (up to 100 per seed)
